admission.justification: The planned reader, renderer and sorter must keep intent distinct from fact and prevent payload-created controls or runtime starts.

applicability: A current live leaf review whose planned read supplies mode planned, before a recorded change set exists.
conditions: The planned page is obtained from its own route; refused or non-planned answers are not recast as a planned payload.
Only the product's declared/subject/effect sorts are offered.
exclusions: This page does not claim implemented behavior or grant a work/review decision.
A payload cannot inject a judgment sort or an alternate top line.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/review/explainer/planned/PlannedReview.test.tsx::starts nothing: no fetch is made and no frame or host channel is mounted; dashboard/src/panels/review/explainer/planned/PlannedReview.test.tsx::renders packet bodies safely, navigates resolved Scope tip addresses while keeping unresolved paths as text, and synchronizes planned tree and reading rows; dashboard/src/panels/review/explainer/ReviewExplainerIntegration.test.tsx::mounts PlannedReview when the leaf is in planning mode (/planned); source-location and unchanged-byte audit: helpers/frontend/source-drift-current-W9.json; no fresh test execution.

statement: A planned review visibly distinguishes intended effects from code facts under the product-owned planned · no changes line, renders statements, labels or explicit absence with inert packets and code-tip-only scope links, shares deterministic effect order between tree and reading rows and starts no model, fetch or frame.
